 -2-  NC: 2023:KHC-D:9129  CRL.P No. 101790 of 2023  ORDER

This petition filed under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure (for short, 'the Cr.P.C.') is by sole accused with a prayer to release him in Crime No.89/2023 of APMC Police Station Belagavi for the offences punishable u/secs.511, 506, 341, 376, 354 IPC.
2.
In support of his petition, petitioner has contended that he is innocent of the offences alleged.
There is inordinate delay in filing the complaint and the same is not properly explained by the prosecution.
There is no prima facie material to proceed against the petitioner.
Petitioner was working as a Peon in Government Polytechnic College at Belagavi on contract basis.
It was his duty to close the doors.
Since the victim girl was alone, on seeing the petitioner, she tried to ran away and when petitioner tried to enquire, she abused him in filthy language and ran away.
On the next day as usual she attended the class and petitioner attended the duty.
However on 13.06.2023, the college authorities have NC: 2023:KHC-D:9129 removed him from service alleging that he misbehaved with the college student.
However there was no complaint or allegations against him.
Colluding with the victim girl, a false complaint has been lodged.
Having regard to the allegations made in the complaint, provisions of Section 376 is not attracted.
At the most it may fall u/sec.354 IPC.
The petitioner is ready and willing to abide by any of the conditions that may be imposed.
Since 14.06.2023, petitioner is in judicial custody and prays to allow the petition.
3. Learned High Court Government Pleader submitted oral objections stating that the petitioner was working as Peon in Government Polytechnic College, Belagavi.
The complainant is a student of the said college studying in fourth semester.
On 05.06.2023 at 4.45 p.m. after finishing class, she went to the washroom to change cloth.
Since there was water spilled on the floor, she went to restroom situated by the side of her classroom and changed her cloth.
However when she was about to leave NC: 2023:KHC-D:9129 room, petitioner/accused came there, dragged her inside the room and tried to kiss her.
When she resisted, he touched her chest.

Though she pushed him and came out of the room, again he went back to her and dragged her inside the room and tried to commit rape on her by pulling her clothes saying that he would do it once (meant have sexual intercouse) and nothing would happened to her.
She managed to push him away and ran.
While she was running away

,
petitioner give threat to her if she disclose this fact to anyone, he will not leave her.
3.1 The complainant brought this fact to the notice of her fiance who is working in Dubai.
He said her that he is coming to India and after discussion, they would take a decision.
On 13.06.2023, her fiance returned from Dubai and after consultation with her family members, she lodged the complaint on 14.06.2023.

sentences.text: Based on the complaint, case is registered and investigation is taken up.
After coming to know about the incident, the petitioner who was appointed on contract NC: 2023:KHC-D:9129 basis has been relieved from services vide order dated 13.06.2023.
Complainant has also given her statement u/sec.164 Cr.P.C. before the jurisdictional Magistrate.

Having regard to the nature of allegations made and the fact that still investigation is going on, at this stage, it would not be proper to release the petitioner on bail and prays to reject the petition.

4. Heard arguments and perused the record.
5.

From the material placed on record, it is evident that at the relevant point of time,
petitioner/accused was working as a Peon in Government Polytechnic College, Belagavi on contract basis.
The complainant is a student of the said college studying in fourth semester.

As evident from the complaint averments as well as her statement given before the jurisdictional Magistrate, on 05.06.2023 at 4.45 p.m. after finishing class, victim girl went to the washroom to change cloth.
Since water had spilled on the floor, she went to restroom situated by the side of her classroom and changed clothes.

However when she was NC: 2023:KHC-D:9129 about to leave room,
petitioner/accused came there, dragged her inside the room and tried to kiss her.

When she resisted,
he touched her chest.
Though she pushed him and came out of the room, again he dragged her inside the room, touched her private part and tried to commit rape on her by pulling her clothes.
She managed to push him away and ran.
While she was running away, petitioner give threat to her that if she disclose this fact to anyone, he will not leave her.
The complainant brought this fact to the notice of her fiance who is working in Dubai.
He said her that he is coming to India and after discussion, they would take a decision.

On 13.06.2023, her fiance returned from Dubai and after consultation with her family members, she lodged the complaint on 14.06.2023.
6.
Petitioner was arrested on 14.06.2023.
The allegations made against the petitioner are serious and it requires thorough investigation.
It is also necessary to ascertain whether he is also involved in similar incidents.

Since the investigation is yet to be completed, it would not be in the interest of prosecution to release the petitioner on bail and accordingly, the following:
ORDER Petition filed U/sec.439 Cr.P.C. is rejected.

Sd/-
